title: Senior-heavy NBH chasing region championship - NewsBreak
text: NORTH BAY HAVEN, Fla. (WMBB) – With the high school volleyball regular season just around the corner, the North Bay Haven Buccaneers believe this could be their year to make a serious run at the state tournament. The Buccaneers are coming off a record-setting 2024 campaign, finishing with 22 wins and a trip to the regional finals. This fall, they return eight seniors, nearly all of their core production from last season. Among the returning players, a half dozen earned All-County honors a year ago, including standout Reese Warren, who is expected to be one of the frontrunners for 2025 Player of the Year. For the senior class, this season is about making one final push while also building a legacy for the next generation of Buccaneers. “All of us seniors, we’re like a tight little family,” said senior Kaitlyn Smith. “We’ve grown up through this program, and now in our final year, we’re ready to push forward. These younger girls are watching us because after we graduate, we’re handing it off to them, and we want to leave them with a program they can be proud of.” Junior Abigail Christoph echoed that sentiment, adding that playing alongside the veteran group has helped shape her own leadership. “It gives me a sense of comfort playing with so much experience,” Christoph said. “They know how to lead you, and when it’s my turn to lead, I’ll know their words of advice.” After last season’s Elite Eight appearance, the team has its sights set on getting even further this year. Head coach Emersonn Cabatu said his players have made their goals clear throughout the summer. “They keep telling me, ‘We want to go to state,’ and I tell them, let’s focus on what we do best, which is focusing on ourselves, and the results will come,” Cabatu said. “As John Wooden once said, ‘Focus on the process, and the win, the result is just a by-product of your effort.’ We want to focus on the effort. If the wins come, great. If they don’t, we learn and press on and hopefully win the next time.” North Bay Haven opens its season visiting Chiles High School in Tallahassee on Saturday, Aug. 16.
